_meta.what: Row-by-row review of the 128 n8n daily-signal rows (May–Sep 2026) and the repo's own briefs, done 5 Sep 2026 after the MD saw the first app export and said several entries 'look irrelevant and bad' (TDK, Disney+, Nissan …). Applied at export time (intel/site_export.py) — the database keeps every row; the app shows screened rows under 'Screened out' with the reason, collapses duplicates into the kept row, and tags rows that still need a human check.
_meta.how: Each row was checked against: the live sponsor table (existing F1/FE partner → screened), the blocklist and the approached list, the ICP (B2B, deal-capable, capacity ≥ $1B valuation or $100M ARR or public), whether the row is a rights-holder/team/broadcaster rather than a prospect, duplicate entries of the same trigger, and obvious data faults (undisclosed decision-maker, wrong source, inconsistent facts).
_meta.statuses: screened_out (with reason code) · duplicate_of (kept key) · keep_flagged (needs a human check before it is shown as a clean signal) · keep (default for anything not listed)

reason_codes.existing_partner: already an F1 / FE / team partner (sponsor table or the row itself says so)
reason_codes.rights_holder: a team, the championship, a broadcaster or a supplier — not a prospect
reason_codes.approached: already approached by the 1440 team — never re-pitch cold
reason_codes.off_profile: consumer / B2C, or a category with no B2B sponsorship logic
reason_codes.no_trigger: no capital or leadership event — an association, not a signal
reason_codes.below_capacity: fails the capacity gate (valuation < $1B and no $100M ARR / listing)
reason_codes.too_early: seed / first institutional money; brand budget not there yet
reason_codes.category_conflict: conflicts with a supplier category the series already locks (tyres, fuel)

_meta.key: date|company (company as recorded); matched case-insensitively on the normalised company name

2026-09-05|BYD.reason: stale: The recorded trigger (trial production at the Szeged, Hungary plant, electrive report of 2 Feb 2026) is more than 90 days before the row's date: 5 Sep 2026 is 215 days after the report, and the Mayor of Szeged had confirmed trial production in January 2026. The row's forward-looking facts have also moved: series production, recorded as 'expected from Q2 2026', has been reported as delayed to the fourth quarter of 2026 (just-auto, 'BYD sets Hungary production for fourth quarter of 2026'), and the '1 MW ultra-fast chargers live in Europe in 2026' line traces to a September 2025 CnEVPost item, not to the trigger. The only in-window motorsport fact is that Executive Vice President Stella Li met F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali (5 Jun 2026) and FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem (6 Jun 2026) at the Monaco GP about a manufacturer-level F1 entry (team, power unit or technical partner), and Li has said BYD 'will never participate in Formula 1 just to put a sticker on the side of a car'; Formula E CEO Jeff Dodds says the series remains in regular talks with BYD. Those are direct manufacturer-to-rights-holder negotiations, not a team-sponsorship lane an agency can originate, and they sit 92 days before the row's date. No BYD/Denza partnership with Envision Racing or any FE team was found. Re-surface only on a fresh, dated event: series production actually starting at Szeged, or a BYD announcement of the form its F1/FE involvement will take.

2026-09-05|Rivian.reason: stale: The row's trigger is an InsideEVs feature of 14 Apr 2026 quoting management's 'inflection year' language — a secondary source 144 days before the row's date, outside the 90-day window. The fresh primary event inside the window is the Q2 2026 print (Rivian newsroom and SEC 8-K, 30 Jul 2026): R2 customer deliveries began 9 Jun, Q2 deliveries were 12,194, revenue $1.658B (+27%), 2026 delivery guidance raised to 65,000–70,000 — but the same release cut 2026 capital expenditure by about $250M at the midpoint and the quarter's net loss was $837M, so it is a cost-discipline quarter, not a brand-budget expansion. Marketing sits under a Chief Customer Officer (Greg Revelle, appointed 12 Jan 2026) with no CMO planned, and the company's 2026 brand spend is going into owned R2 events (SXSW, city block parties, the Caruso showroom and charging deal). The Formula E form is the harder problem: Rivian is a manufacturer, not a Gen4-registered one, so its only route is a Cupra-style brand title on a customer entry. The thin row's team, DS Penske, loses DS at the end of Season 12 (announced 20 Mar 2026) and Penske had still not registered as a manufacturer or announced its Season 13 alignment (The Race, motorsport.com), which the repo's team profile marks 'do not target until resolved'. Re-surface if Penske announces a Season 13 identity that leaves a title lane open, or if Rivian itself signals a motorsport programme.

2026-09-05|Wärtsilä Energy Storage (RCT.reason: contradicted: The event is real and in-window (Wärtsilä stock-exchange release, 15 Jun 2026: its global Energy Storage business, about 480 employees and EUR 694 million net sales, goes into a 50/50 joint venture with RCT Solutions GmbH; Energy Storage ceases to be a reporting segment from Q2 2026; RCT's Peter Fath becomes CEO of the venture after closing), but the row's thesis, a deal-capable standalone brand scored 70 with a 6-10 week horizon, is contradicted by the same primary source. Closing was only 'expected in the third quarter of 2026' subject to regulatory approvals AND 'arrangement of a financing package'; no completion, legal name or brand has been announced as of 5 Sep 2026 (searched Wärtsilä newsroom, Inderes, Energy-Storage.News, MarketScreener), so there is no company, leadership page or marketing owner to approach. The release states the venture 'is expected to be loss-making in 2026 driven by recent low order intake as well as costs related to transformation actions, consisting mainly of write-down of capitalized R&D', with an estimated EUR -40 to -50 million impact on Wärtsilä's 2026 operating result and positive results only 'towards the end of 2027'. A carve-out arranged to stop the parent reporting a loss-making segment, still raising its financing, is not a business that funds a multi-year Formula E partnership in 2026-27; an honest score is in the 50s (capacity and urgency both weak), below the 70 threshold, so no case is built. Sponsor-table context for a future re-look: Envision Group (Envision Racing's title parent) is the grid's incumbent battery/storage name and rules that team out; Shell sits on Lola Yamaha ABT and TotalEnergies on DS Penske in the energy category; ABB is the championship title partner. No motorsport tie found for Wärtsilä or RCT leadership. Re-surface at closing, once the venture has a name, a leadership page and a financing package, and reassess against the 2027 Formula E season.
